comment: PROPOSAL for owner review (REL-041..050). Nothing here is applied: DNS (Namecheap), certificates and the demo host change only in the owner's daytime slot. Simulated by tools/portal_check.py.

flh.vanquisher.world.purpose: the public front door: a static page that names FLH and links to the public demo; no application, no form, no sign-in, no invitation
flh.vanquisher.world.target: static hosting chosen by the owner (proposal: GitHub Pages, like the apex); never a proxy to an FLH server
flh.vanquisher.world.tls: issued by the static host for the custom domain

demo.flh.vanquisher.world.purpose: the existing read-only public demo (Demo lane), moved off the portal name
demo.flh.vanquisher.world.target: the demo instance's Elastic IP: nginx (flh-public-https) in front of the loopback demo server
demo.flh.vanquisher.world.tls: Let's Encrypt via certbot webroot on the demo host (flh-public-https --host demo.flh.vanquisher.world)

app.flh.vanquisher.world.purpose: the invite-only pilot, ONLY after authentication and per-account isolation exist and pass §11
app.flh.vanquisher.world.target: none while pre-launch: no DNS record exists, so no request can reach a private route
open_requires: authentication implemented and REL-055..057 isolation cases PASS
anonymous requests to every private route answer 401
HTTPS with HSTS on the pilot host

unknown_host.how: nginx default server closes the connection; the app's HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS refuses any other Host

staging: no host name at all: SSM port forward to 127.0.0.1 only (plan_check STOPs on ingress, EIP, LB and DNS)

changes.what: create CNAME flh.vanquisher.world -> static host, publish the pre-launch page
changes.rollback: delete the CNAME (TTL 300: wait 5 min) and unpublish the page

changes.what: create A demo.flh.vanquisher.world -> demo Elastic IP
changes.rollback: delete the A record; the demo keeps serving on its previous name until C3

changes.what: run flh-public-https on the demo host for demo.flh.vanquisher.world (certificate + HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS drop-in)
changes.rollback: re-run flh-public-https with the previous host name; the previous certificate stays in /etc/letsencrypt until it expires

changes.what: point flh.vanquisher.world away from the demo (if it was ever the demo's name)
changes.rollback: restore the previous record value recorded before C4 (write it down first)
